lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters arranged in an irregular grid; larger, more isolated spots are visible in the mid-flank posterior to the gills, while smaller, more densely packed spots are located anteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of white blobs, creating a discernible grid of anchor nodes across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel linear features run horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with light upper edges and shadowed lower edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of low-contrast, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily within the lower-posterior quadrant of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark, elongated remora-like silhouette swimming in close proximity to the ventral-lateral region, mid-body.
